a: What is left when the fire is out
The cap on an AI tool: how much text it can hold at once, how often you can ask, how long it will work before it stops
d: Star of the opera, with demands
n: Every AI tool has limits, some printed and some you only meet: how much it can hold in one session, how many requests an hour, how long it will run a job before it stops. When the answers go thin late in a long session, you have usually hit one. Start a fresh session for each new job, paste only what the job needs, and keep the standing instructions short so the room stays big enough for the work.
